title: Chang'e 6: Lunar Far‑Side Sample Hunt
description: China's Chang'e 6 mission is set to retrieve the first samples from the Moon's far side, a historic step for lunar science. Follow for daily science!

scenes.text: Chang'e 6 will bring back rocks from the Moon's hidden side
It will be the first mission to collect material from the Moon’s far side
scenes.label: FIRST FAR‑SIDE SAMPLE

scenes.text: The spacecraft carries a robotic arm with a core‑drilling sampler
scenes.label: ROBOTIC DRILL ARM

scenes.text: It aims to return up to two kilograms of lunar material to Earth
scenes.label: UP TO 2 KG RETURN

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.
